name: bedbank-assistant
description: Personal assistant for Bedbank Global executives: reports, takes actions and keeps you informed through the company gateway.

interface.longDescription: Reports, takes actions and keeps you informed through the Bedbank Global gateway. Sign in once with your Bedbank Slack account; the assistant then acts for you with your own permissions. Connect your email and calendar (Outlook or Google), web search and Google Maps in your app to unlock inbox triage, meeting prep and market checks. It remembers you between conversations.
